description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing SDN routes in Windows using the Host Compute Network (HCN) API. It includes route creation, deletion, querying, and modification functionalities, as well as route representation.

classes.name: HostComputeRoute
classes.description: Represents a Software Defined Network (SDN) route with properties like ID, endpoints, settings, and schema version.

methods.name: ListRoutes
methods.description: Lists all available routes by calling ListRoutesQuery with a default query.

methods.name: ListRoutesQuery
methods.description: Queries routes based on a provided HostComputeQuery object, returning matching routes.

methods.name: GetRouteByID
methods.description: Retrieves a specific route by its ID, returning an error if not found.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new route in the system based on the HostComputeRoute object.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified route from the system.

methods.name: AddEndpoint
methods.description: Adds an endpoint to an existing route by deleting and recreating the route with the new endpoint.

methods.name: RemoveEndpoint
methods.description: Removes an endpoint from a route by deleting and recreating the route without the specified endpoint.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Creates a new route with specified endpoints, destination prefix, next hop, and encapsulation requirement.
